'''Recon-tower 4''' was one of the several [[Sentry tower/Legends|recon-towers]] built on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was perched atop a [[Unidentified Massassi monument|monument]] situated north of the [[Massassi Site/Legends|Massassi Site]]. Recon-tower 4 was manned by [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Osleo Prennert]].<ref name="SWI92" />
